pages.text: Blood belongs to the player who supplied it. By default, someone else cannot inject your blood. Server owners may enable geneSharing in AdvancedGenetics.toml. Drawing blood includes the donor's existing genes.

To remove an ability, fill an Anti-Plasmid with the gene you want removed. Process it with a syringe in the Plasmid Injector, purify the syringe, then inject. The marked gene is removed; other genes remain.
